Long, flowing platinum white hair with straight hime-cut bangs. Slender, narrow almond-shaped eyes in a soft lavender shade. Apparent age of a mature young adult with a serene expression. Slender, graceful build. A traditional miko-inspired outfit consisting of a white kimono top and wide red hakama trousers. Features a decorative hair ornament and a floating paper talisman.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
